summary: Tested routing architecture refactor (Landing -> /info, /vlasnici, /login) and the CRITICAL manual booking slots bug fix. Backend: 9/9 pytest assertions PASS (smart-redirect login data, public booking endpoints without auth, admin slots WITH X-Tenant-ID returns 39 slots, admin slots WITHOUT X-Tenant-ID properly rejected with 400 - confirming the original bug RCA). Frontend Playwright: Landing 3-paths (zakazi/vlasnici/uloguj) PASS; /info advice + referral + Nazad PASS; /vlasnici 'Uskoro otvaramo registraciju' + Nazad PASS; header 'Uloguj se' -> /login PASS (flaky on first attempt, succeeds after networkidle); Super Admin login -> /super-admin PASS; God Mode panel (features/categories/system tabs) PASS; Salon Admin login -> /beauty-studio-bor/admin PASS; Public /beauty-studio-bor loads WITHOUT login (booking wizard visible) PASS. CRITICAL: Manual booking modal Step 2 now shows 10 time slots (17:15-19:30) instead of 'Nema dostupnih termina' - X-Tenant-ID header fix CONFIRMED WORKING.

issues: Date input uses browser's NATIVE date picker (e.g. 06/11/2026 placeholder via <input type=date>) instead of the shadcn Calendar component used elsewhere. Locale-dependent format (MM/DD/YYYY shown for en-US) is confusing for Serbian users who expect DD.MM.YYYY. Recommend swap to shadcn <Calendar/> with Popover.

console_warnings.issue: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The <option> renders a child <span> (likely from i18n/text-wrap helper), which is invalid HTML and causes hydration mismatch on every modal open. Replace the <span> wrapper inside <option> with plain text {s.name} ({s.duration_min} min - {s.price} RSD).

action_items: Fix invalid HTML in /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx around line 387: remove <span> child from <option>; render plain text only. Same likely applies to the worker <option> below it. This eliminates the hydration error.
Replace native <input type=date> in ManualBookingModal Korak 2 with shadcn Calendar in a Popover, matching the rest of the design system (Serbian locale, DD.MM.YYYY).

AdminDashboard.jsx line 240-247 (fetchSlots): The fix is in place - axios.post now passes { headers } as 3rd arg, headers includes Authorization + X-Tenant-ID (line 196). Backend test confirms slots return non-empty (39 slots for future date).

AdminLogin.jsx line 24-32 (redirectUser): correctly branches on role=='super_admin' -> /super-admin, then userData.slug || slug -> /:slug/admin, else /. Backend /api/auth/login returns slug for admin users (routes.py line 311-313). Verified end-to-end.
LandingPage.jsx: Country selection removed and replaced with 2 main paths + discrete header login - matches spec. data-testids: book-appointment-btn, salon-owners-btn, header-login-btn all stable.
InfoPage.jsx & OwnersPage.jsx: Use <a href='/'> for Nazad which causes full page reload. Suggest react-router <Link to='/'> for SPA navigation consistency. Minor.
Previous iteration (34) flagged that tenant_bsb_001.owner_email='bornaja23@gmail.com' (super admin's email) - still an open critical security issue. NOT in scope for this iteration but un-fixed.

rca_of_the_issue: RCA confirmed for the 'Nema dostupnih termina' bug: AdminDashboard.jsx ManualBookingModal.fetchSlots (line 240-255) was calling axios.post(`${API}/reservations/available-slots`, {...body}) without the third config arg, so neither Authorization nor X-Tenant-ID headers were sent. Backend route /api/reservations/available-slots requires X-Tenant-ID and returns HTTP 400 'Missing X-Tenant-ID header' when absent. Axios catch block swallowed the 400 and set availableSlots=[] -> UI rendered 'Nema dostupnih termina'. Fix: third argument { headers } added (headers = {Authorization, X-Tenant-ID} defined at line 196). Verified by backend test test_slots_without_tenant_header_fails (returns 400) and test_slots_with_tenant_header (returns 39 slots). Frontend Playwright confirmed: opening Nova Rezervacija -> selecting Šišanje + Suzana -> Dalje -> Step 2 shows 10 time slots (17:15 through 19:30).
